record_title: Sharp strip-defect asymptotics for the double Hilbert transform
limitations: The sharp formulas concern diagonal tubes with transverse cutoffs and do not classify general near-invariant planar sets; the finite-perimeter expansion fixes the one-dimensional set as epsilon tends to zero; no global extremality statement is claimed; the direct source is very recent so an unindexed contemporaneous refinement may exist; independent audit has not been performed.
